title: 4 suspects busted, P81.6 M 'shabu' seized at Batangas port
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Authorities arrested four drug suspects and seized an estimated P81.6 million worth of suspected shabu at Batangas Port in Barangay Sta. Clara, Batangas City early Wednesday,…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Authorities arrested four drug suspects and seized an estimated P81.6 million worth of suspected shabu at Batangas Port in Barangay Sta. Clara, Batangas City early Wednesday, according to the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG). The PCG said its personnel, together with those from the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA), intercepted 12 kilograms of suspected shabu and arrested the four suspects, aged 18,29, 30 and 41 during a joint operation. PCG spokesperson Commodore Noemie Cayabyab said four arrested suspects are residents of Malate, Manila, and Maluso, Basilan.
